notes.title: Patch Notes #11237

tags.bug: [*] Fixed an issue where high FPS could cause audio to break;
[*] Fixed an issue where characters could get stuck while climbing through open windows;
[*] Fixed an issue when hosting or joining a game with player names containing special characters like `:` or `\%`;
[*] Fixed an issue where a hero would start climbing a ladder while aiming simultaneously;
[*] Fixed an issue where, after killing a stunned enemy, the stun icon would reappear over the dead body following a save and full load;
[*] Fixed an issue with picking up collectibles while in a prone position;
[*] Improved handling of stacked keys to prevent rare softlocks;
[*] Tweaked vehicle behavior after save/load sequences to ensure proper movement;
[*] The tank and commander will no longer get stuck. Both will now complete their movement orders correctly, and the commander will always reach the regroup point;
[*] Fixed ledges to prevent Heniu from getting trapped;
[*] The executioner squad will no longer be triggered by the sound of Youngster running in uniform.
[*] Fixed an issue where tags were not cleared from Helga's wounded partisans, ensuring they follow orders correctly;
[*] The "Defeat enemies" quest will no longer reset after a full load.

tags.feature: [*] Added a feature to limit FPS when the app is out of focus;

tags.balance_change: [*] Adjusted the visibility of online games on Steam;

tags.feature: [*] Patrol squads will now follow their routes, even if tutorials are turned off mid-level.
[b]TRADING CARDS[/b] are available, check them out!

notes.title: DESTRUCTIVE CREATIONS IS 10 YEARS OLD! 🥳
notes.content:
[h3]As part of our celebrations, we've chronicled the [b]DC history[/b] and showcased [b]new development[/b] and [b]publishing[/b] projects currently in the works ⤵️[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Mu8kJrtffGc;full][/previewyoutube]It might not be as fun as watching a cat fail compilation or your wedding video, featuring your favorite drunk uncle, but it’s light and fun whether you’re a DC fan, a DC hater [i](cheers to you!)[/i] or yet indifferent, but curious! 🎉🎉🎉
[hr][/hr][h3]Starting today, you can also try the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/][b]DEMO[/b][/url] of our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/][b]63 DAYS[/b][/url] title! 😎[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202120/63_Days/ Coming of age as a part of the first generation born free, WWII stripped me of my family, home, and future. Now I'm left with only one choice: to get my revenge and independence, or die trying. The odds are against us: will our tactics, stealth and teamwork be enough?
